meta.name: Tallow Wharf
meta.note: Campaign map (CMG, mission-framework PLAN 5). World metres, x east, z north (north up), canal along the south edge (z 0-6). Two missions start here: Three Grey Coats (mission.start w1-canal-steps, sections W1 -> W2 -> W3 (crossing, no step) -> W4) and Two-Key Ledger (mission.start w2-arcade, W2 -> W3 -> W4); their mission nodes come from the TGC / TKL slices. The validator spine is linear (W1 -> W2 -> W3 -> W4, no route may skip a section), so TGC crosses W3 with no TGC step there: down the roof fire escape into the east wing, then the strongroom passage and the coal chute (vent unlock) into the coal yard and out the cartway. Lighting (LR1 / G279): lit by default, darkness made by switches, shot lamps and isolated circuits; mixed zones where they play better (each encounter note). Every value is a declared target, pending V6.

W2.name: Arcade lofts
forced_coop: coop_boost + team_rope / team_pull (arcade -> walkway: the first up by the boost at the west pier, the second by the rope there or the pull-up at the east lip)
team_throw (south lofts -> north lofts over the lightwell)
team_throw (arcade roof -> counting house roof, spine)

W3.name: Counting house
forced_coop: vent unlock: coop_boost into the coal chute + bolted chute hatch and coal yard door (the only ways into the coal yard, the choke)

W4.name: Wharf sheds
forced_coop: coop_boost (back lane -> shed three, the lane-side clerestory)

spaces.function: Stone landing steps from the canal where the market barges unload; the crew comes ashore here (map start)
spaces.note: custom: an 8 x 10 landing has no sheet class (yard min 14). Sees the lit fish hall clock 35 m north over the stall roofs (TGC step 1 seen_from). Light: one canal lamp at the water edge (photocell), the landing top in the stall shadow; dark by default at the top step (entry vantage, out of every market patrol).

spaces.function: Porters' tea stall at the head of the steps: urn, bench, awning; the porters gossip here (TGC overheard lead)
spaces.note: Open-air break pocket (break_room sizes, open sky). Light: paraffin lamp on the counter (lit by default, turned down by hand or shot); the dark nook between the urn crates and the canal rail is within 3 m of the bench (overheard trigger).

spaces.function: The night market square: rows of fish and produce stalls under warm lamps, the fish hall clock on its north side, market wardens on rounds
spaces.note: ESTIMATES (pending V6). Guards: 2 market wardens on loops, the lamp trimmer (back-and-forth), 1 warden posted under the clock (the three grey coats are NPCs, not guards). Light (LR1, lit by default): stall lamps on two strings, each switched at its row end, plus the clock face lamp (unswitchable, clockwork); dark aisles between stall backs (mixed zone). Made dark by: the row switches, shooting stall lamps; shadow 0.5 with both strings on. Vantage: the stall-roof gallery 4.5 m up on the west side, dark (no gallery lamps), concealed from every floor patrol (guards do not look up); 4.5 m stall cover hides the back row.

spaces.function: Stall-roof gallery: the plank walk along the top of the west stall row, used by the lamp trimmer; vantage over the market
spaces.note: corridor class for a 4 m walk (open sky, exterior). Dark: no lamps on the gallery; the trimmer's ladder is taken home at night (why the boost lip is co-op).

spaces.function: Market warden's office on the gallery: desk with the tally book of who came and went, the stair down to the floor
spaces.note: Lit desk lamp (switch by the gallery door). Two ways out besides the gallery door: the warden's stair (bolted at its foot) and the inspection hatch over the fish hall, so it is no dead end.

spaces.function: The covered fish hall under the clock tower: ice benches, scales, porters loading; its service shutter opens on the back passage to the arcade
spaces.note: lobby class = a 14 x 28 hall with a 6 m roof (no market-hall class on the sheet). ESTIMATES (pending V6). Guards: 2 porters (talking pair at the scales), 1 hall watchman on a loop past the shutter. Light: pendant lamps on one circuit switched at the arch (lit by default), ice benches throw pools; dark west bay under the warden's office (mixed zone). Dark by: the arch switch, shooting pendants. Vantage: the gallery's north end through the hall's open side bay, dark, out of the patrols' view. Choke of W1: every route to the exit passes this hall and its back wall (shutter or barred door).

spaces.function: The fish hall's back service passage, where barrows run to the arcade end; quiet at night
spaces.note: Quiet connector (LD 3.8): one bulkhead lamp at the arcade end; glimpses the arcade's glazed roof.

spaces.function: The covered shopping arcade under a glazed roof: shop fronts below, a loft walkway along the north side, the public stair to the back lofts
spaces.note: ESTIMATES (pending V6). Checkpoint at its west end (the arch from the W1 passage). Guards: the arcade beadle (loop), 2 of Pell's men (one posted at the stair foot, one walking). Light: gas-style pendants on one switch by the west arch (lit by default), shop windows dark except the pie shop; the north-west bay by the coal bunker stays dark (mixed zone). Dark by: the arch switch, shooting pendants. Vantage: the arcade roof skylight ridge (TGC BEAT: the W2 vantage), dark, above every patrol.

spaces.function: The pie shop: counter, ovens, a back stair to its loft; decoy Garrow eats here (TGC)
spaces.note: storage sizes for a shop unit (no retail class). Lit shop window (switch behind the counter).

spaces.function: Loft walkway: the balcony along the north side of the arcade at loft level, serving the loft doors; sees the reading room window
spaces.note: No stair reaches it from the arcade (the tenants use their own back stairs): boost and rope at its west pier, pull-up at its east lip. Dark (no walkway lamps); within earshot of the pie loft window (TKL step 1). Choke of W2: every route to the roof passes it.

spaces.function: Pie shop loft: flour store and the table where the night clerk eats his supper and telephones (TKL)
spaces.note: Lit window onto the walkway (switch by the stair head).

spaces.function: Pawnbroker's loft: pledge shelves and the desk with Pell's courier rota (TGC optional); decoy Fenn waits here
spaces.note: Lit desk lamp; an open-fronted taking-in bay over the lightwell faces the reading room (the old hoist bay: no lintel, 3.6 m clear to the hoist hood, so the throw arc is free).

spaces.function: Subscription reading room in the back lofts: Teale's lit table at the window, a dark stacks aisle behind (TGC step 3)
spaces.note: storage class sizes (6.5 x 16, conditional encounter, short side >= 6). ESTIMATES (pending V6). Guards: Pell's minder at the stair head (post), the reading-room keeper (loop), a night reader (static). Light: table lamps (lit by default, each with its own switch), the stacks aisle dark (mixed zone). Dark by: lamp switches, the landing switch. Vantage: the arcade roof edge across the 3.5 m lightwell, dark.

spaces.function: Clock-mender's back loft: benches and cased clocks; Teale's bolt point (A11), reached only over the lightwell or from the reading room landing
spaces.note: Dark (the mender has gone home); his door to the landing is bolted on his side.

spaces.function: The empty corner loft at the arcade's east end: its window looks over the arcade lane at the brass plate on Gaunt & Lisle's door (TKL lead); roof hatch to the leads
spaces.note: BEAT "loft window". Dark, unlet.

spaces.function: The arcade roof: lead flats over the north loft row beside the glazed skylight ridge; the arcade-lane edge faces the counting house roof
spaces.note: custom: route surface (roof walk) with no sheet class. BEAT names: TGC "arcade roof skylight" (W2 vantage) and TKL "loft roof" are this one space. Dark by default; the lane edge has a 1.1 m parapet, broken out for 3 m where the old lane bridge landed (the throw point).

spaces.function: Gaunt & Lisle's flat lead roof over both wings: copper clock turret, the west light-well lantern, the coal yard hoist beam; the W3 vantage
spaces.note: custom: roof walk, no sheet class. Sees the east yard, the east gate lamp and the porter's lodge lamp (TKL). Dark by default; the turret clock face is lit (landmark).

spaces.function: The counting house's walled back yard: the east gate (keypad door) into the east wing, the porter's lodge, the iron fire escape
spaces.note: W3 checkpoint (TKL). ESTIMATES (pending V6). Guards: the yard watchman (loop), a dog on a running line by the lodge, the porter (from the lodge on the twist). Light: the gate lamp over the keypad door (lit by default, switch inside the lodge), the lodge window; the north wall line under the fire escape is dark (mixed zone). Dark by: the lodge switch, shooting the gate lamp. Phase early: W3 is TKL's second of three sections (TGC only crosses its roof and coal yard); the linear spine puts it third on the map.

spaces.function: Porter's lodge at the yard: kettle, key board, the tell-tale bell from the strongroom (TKL twist)
spaces.note: Lit lodge lamp (comes on at the twist).

spaces.function: East wing clerks' hall: high desks, ledger presses, the partners' office and the east key post off it
spaces.note: ESTIMATES (pending V6). Guards: 2 night clerks (static at desks), the porter on rounds (loop), a messenger (back-and-forth to the front hall). Light: green desk lamps (each switched) and one hall pendant at the front-hall door (lit by default); the press aisles are dark (mixed zone). Dark by: the hall switch, desk lamps, shooting the pendant. Vantage: the tall yard windows from the dark wall line of the east yard.

spaces.function: The partners' office: the day book under a warm desk lamp (TKL optional, no reward)
spaces.note: Dead end that pays off (the day book, 7 m deep). The `reward` type and tag are the validator's dead-end payoff kind; the campaign optional gives no item (Michael 2026-10-25, folded plan Q19: "None (Recommended)").

spaces.function: East key post: an arched alcove with the strongroom's east key lock and the brass notice "Both keys. Together."
spaces.note: Dead end (objective, 6 m). 21 m from the west post, no line of sight between them (the front hall walls); radio is the link.

spaces.function: Strongroom passage between the wings: the strongroom door, the grille (watch spot down the east corridor), the coal chute's iron door, the coal yard door
spaces.note: One caged bulkhead lamp (emergency circuit, unswitchable: a vandal cage); the chute end is dark.

spaces.function: The strongroom: ledger presses and the deed boxes; opened only by the two key posts turned together (TKL)
spaces.note: Dead end (objective, 8 m deep). Dark until the door opens.

spaces.function: West wing clerks' hall round a top-lit light well with an iron gallery at 4.2 m (stair down to the hall): dark stacks, the copying desks, the west key post
spaces.note: ESTIMATES (pending V6). Guards: a night clerk (static), the stacks porter (loop), the front-hall watchman (back-and-forth into the wing). Light: copying-desk lamps (each switched) and the light-well lantern (moonlight); stacks dark (mixed zone). Dark by: desk lamps, the front-hall switch. Vantage: down the glazed light-well lantern from the roof rail, dark.

spaces.function: West key post: an arched alcove with the strongroom's west key lock and its brass notice
spaces.note: Dead end (objective, 6 m).

spaces.function: The coal chute: a 1.2 x 1.5 brick chute from the iron door 4.4 m up the passage wall, falling to the hatch 2.2 m up the coal yard wall over the coal heap; storey 4.4 is the iron door's sill, where the boost lands
spaces.note: custom: a duct as a space (crouch, scale sheet 1.2 x 1.5); player only. Vent unlock (PLAN 4a): leg-up into it, crawl, open the yard hatch, then unbar the coal yard door for the partner.

spaces.function: Coal yard behind the west wing: coal bays, the hoist beam from the roof, the cart gate to the cartway
spaces.note: Choke of W3: every route to the exit passes it (the chute hatch, or the passage door barred on the yard side). One yard lamp on a photocell over the cart gate; coal bays dark.

spaces.function: Covered cartway from the coal yard through the boundary building to the wharf back lane
spaces.note: Quiet connector; one lamp at the lane mouth.

spaces.function: The wharf back lane behind the sheds: the shed two loading shutter, the shed yard gate, the crane's north leg
spaces.note: corridor class for a 4 m service lane (open sky). Dark by default; one lamp at the yard gate.

spaces.function: Crane gantry: the walkway of the quay crane over the shed yard and shed three's north-light roof; the W4 vantage
spaces.note: corridor class (4 m walkway, open sky). The crane's red lamp hangs off the jib over the jetty (landmark, unswitchable aviation lamp). Dark walkway.

spaces.function: Shed three: tea chests in bond, the candle-stencilled chest (TGC), a dark side aisle, the lit loading door onto the jetty
spaces.note: storage class (14 x 18 bonded store, conditional encounter, short side >= 6). ESTIMATES (pending V6). Guards (late band, CMS 2026-10-24): a tea barge is being landed on the night tide for the morning sale, so the shed works through the night under bond: the bond tally clerk (static at his desk), the customs locker who holds the bond keys (post at the loading door), 2 dockers stacking (talking pair), a docker on the hand truck (back-and-forth stacks -> loading door), the shed foreman (loop through both aisles, the dark side aisle included). Light: the loading-door floodlight (lit by default, switch inside the door) and two pendant rows on one switch; the side aisle dark (mixed zone). Dark by: the pendant switch, shooting the floodlight. Vantage: down through the north-light roof glazing from the gantry, dark.

spaces.function: Shed two: an empty bonded store, its dark aisle running from the lane shutter to the canal door (TKL)
spaces.note: No guards (quiet connector). Dark; one emergency lamp at the canal door.

spaces.function: The shed yard: open quay between the lane gate and the canal, carts and barrows, the yard watch; the minders' walk after the TGC twist
spaces.note: ESTIMATES (pending V6). Guards: yard watchman (loop), a dog handler with a dog (2), the crane watchman (post at the yard leg), and from the TGC twist Pell's 2 minders (walking pair between shed three and the quay edge). Light: one yard floodlight at the lane gate (lit by default, switch in the gate box) and quay lamps on a photocell; the cart lines and coal heaps are dark (mixed zone). Dark by: the gate box switch, shooting the floodlight. Vantage: the crane gantry, 10 m up, dark.

spaces.function: Canal ledge: the stone towpath step at water level under the quay wall, from the quay ladder to the jetty staging
spaces.note: corridor class (3 m ledge, open sky). Dark (water level, under the quay lamps' cut-off).

spaces.function: The jetty staging along the canal front of sheds two and three, the boat moored under the crane jib
spaces.note: corridor class (4 m staging, open sky). Choke of W4: every route to the boat passes it. The crane's red lamp is overhead; shed three's loading door floods its middle (dark by its inside switch).

spaces.function: The launch moored at the jetty under the crane: the extraction (both players aboard)
spaces.note: custom: a boat deck. Dark, the engine idling.
